svg.title: Magnetoelastic cubic coupling: tensor-to-Voigt engineering strain mapping and executable prescribed-strain subset
svg.desc: Panel (a) maps the symmetric 3x3 strain tensor epsilon_ij to Fullmag's 6-component engineering-Voigt vector (epsilon_11, epsilon_22, epsilon_33, gamma_23, gamma_13, gamma_12) with gamma_ij = 2 epsilon_ij, explaining normal B_1 stretch terms versus the factor of 2 in shear coupling 2 B_2 epsilon_12 m_1 m_2 = B_2 gamma_12 m_1 m_2. Panel (b) traces the Fullmag object graph from ElasticMaterial, ElasticBody, MagnetostrictionLaw, and MechanicalLoad to Magnetoelastic, separating the executable FEM CPU/GPU prescribed-strain subset from semantic-only mechanics and FDM plans.
svg.text: Magnetoelastic Interaction: Engineering-Voigt Strain Convention and Executable Subset
Cubic B₁ / B₂ coupling to prescribed strain (γ_ij = 2 ε_ij) vs unimplemented coupled mechanics
Tensor-to-Voigt Strain Mapping & Factor-of-2 Shear Coupling
Symmetric Strain Tensor εij → Public 6-Component Engineering Voigt εeng
Shear sum: B2(ε12m1m2 + ε21m2m1) = 2 B2 ε12 m1 m2 = B2 γ12 m1 m2.
Favors m along/perp to strain axis by sign of B1.
Kernel reads Voigt γij and halves: εij = 0.5 γij.
Variational Effective Field Hmel & Quantitative Example
• Local division by Ms,i: nonmagnetic nodes zeroed; total energy Emel = ∑i wmel,i Vlump,i.
• Zero strain gives Hmel = 0 and Emel = 0 identically; verified by finite-difference ∂E/∂m.
Fullmag Object Graph & Executable Subset vs Mechanics Roadmap
C11, C12, C44 [Pa], ρ [kg m−3], ηmech
Note: API checks C12 > 0 (not full stability)
Links geometry domain to elastic constants
IR coupling record referencing named magnet, elastic body, and law
EXECUTABLE SUBSET: Prescribed-Strain Cubic B1/B2 (FEM CPU & FEM GPU)
• FEM CPU & GPU (Double): Evaluates Hmel & lumped-mass Emel from MechanicalLoadIR::PrescribedStrain.
• Uniform or per-node 6-component Voigt strain; one Magnetoelastic coupling term; same-mesh-only.
• Authoring boundary: Stage-first study builder does not yet attach the complete mechanics graph
end-to-end; Python objects currently verify IR construction and validation contracts.
• FDM CPU & GPU: Local field routines/kernels exist, but complete public FDM plan is REJECTED.
• Isotropic λs: Rejected without declared elastic/symmetry B1/B2 mapping (no lossy fallback).
• Coupled Mechanics: QuasistaticElasticity, Elastodynamics, MechanicalBoundaryCondition, and
two-way magnetostriction remain semantic roadmap (no displacement solve or acoustic damping yet).
Fullmag prescribed-strain magnetoelasticity divides H_mel by local M_{s,i} and targets physical cubic stability (C₄₄>0, C₁₁−C₁₂>0, C₁₁+2C₁₂>0).
